description: Recent material changes across investment-migration programmes (launches, closures, threshold/mobility/regulatory changes) + current status counts, PLUS pathway_field_changes (official-source field-level diffs per country x pathway, from->to + cited source) and official_legislation_changes (changes detected directly on official government/gazette sources). The freshest, primary-source-verified record — use for "what changed recently / latest" questions. Pass cc to filter to one country.

cc.description: Country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "PT", "AE", "KN") or its name in any of the 11 site languages ("Portugal", "Schweiz", "UAE"); input_notes shows how it was read.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Responses can be large; use this to keep the answer small.

name: get_recent_changes

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.

title: Recent Programme Changes
